 The Brief
 If you're looking to vote early in the 2026 general election, you'll have to vote this weekend. 
 The last day for early voting is Oct. 31 in Florida, though some counties allow early voting until Nov. 1. Scroll down to find your county and early voting polling locations. 
 Floridians can vote at any location during early voting . On Election Day , Nov. 3, you must vote at your assigned polling location. 
 ORLANDO, Fla. - Early voting ends this weekend in Florida. So, those looking to vote before Election Day in the 2026 general election, have until Saturday or Sunday, depending on your county, to cast their ballot.
 During early voting, you can vote at any precinct. On Election Day, Nov. 3, you must vote at your assigned polling location. 
 When does early voting end in Florida? County-by-county guide
 Local perspective:
 Early voting in Florida ends on Oct. 31, while some counties have extended early voting to Nov. 1 for the 2026 midterm election.  Find the last day of early voting in your county below, hours, and click the link to find polling locations.
 Brevard County: Oct. 31, 8 a.m. - 4 p.m. - Early voting locations 
 Flagler County: Oct. 31, 10 a.m. - 6 p.m. - Early voting locations 
 Lake County: Oct. 31, 10 a.m. - 6 p.m. - Early voting locations 
 Marion County: Oct. 31, 8 a.m. - 6 p.m. - Early voting locations 
 Orange County: Nov. 1, 8 a.m. - 8 p.m. - Early voting locations 
 Osceola County: Nov. 1, 8 a.m. - 8 p.m. - Early voting locations 
 Polk County: Oct. 31 - Early voting locations 
 Seminole County: Nov. 1, 7 a.m. - 7 p.m. - Early voting locations 
 Sumter County: Oct. 31, 10 a.m. - 6 p.m. - Early voting locations 
 Volusia County: Oct. 31, 8 a.m. - 6 p.m. - Early voting locations 
 What do I need to vote in the general election?
 To vote in Florida's general election, you need to be registered to vote (the deadline for the 2026 election was Oct. 5).
 You need to bring an ID with a valid photo and a signature, such as:
 Florida driver's license 
 Florida ID card 
 U.S. Passport 
 Debit or Credit Card 
 Military ID 
 Student ID 
 Retirement center ID 
 Neighborhood association ID 
 Public assistance ID 
 Veteran health ID card 
 Government ID 
 While your voter information card has good information on it, such as your polling precinct on Election Day, it will not be accepted as a form of ID.
 Voting on Election Day
 Election Day for Florida's 2026 general election is Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026.
 Polls will be open from 7 a.m. - 7 p.m. local time (parts of the Florida Panhandle fall under Central Times). As long as you are in line before 7 p.m., you will be allowed to vote.
 Where do I vote? Find your polling location
 On Election Day, voters must cast their ballot at their assigned polling location. To find yours, you need to visit your county's Supervisor of Elections website. Type in your name and address, and it will then tell you where your polling site.
 Brevard County Supervisor of Elections 
 Flagler County Supervisor of Elections 
 Lake County Supervisor of Elections

 When are election results released?
 Shortly after the polls close at 7 p.m., initial election results should be released, and will then be continuously updated until all precincts count and report their results.
 The Source: This information was gathered from several sources, including the Florida Division of Elections and each county's Supervisor of Elections websites.
